entry.title: Grievers Don't Owe You An Explanation!

media:group.media:title: Grievers Don't Owe You An Explanation!
media:group.media:description:
What happens when the world expects you to stay broken forever?
In this video, I’m talking about something many grieving people silently carry : the guilt, judgment, and pressure that can come when you begin smiling again, laughing again, loving again, or simply living again after devastating loss.
Healing is not betrayal. Joy is not disrespect. And moving forward does NOT mean you loved them any less.
Every grieving person walks a different path. Some people rebuild quietly. Some never remarry. Some find purpose in serving others. Some laugh again quickly. Some take years just to breathe again. None of those journeys belong to strangers on the internet.
We do not owe the world an explanation for surviving.
God never asked us to stay buried in our sorrow forever. The ability to love again, hope again, dream again, and experience joy again are gifts from Him, not something we should apologize for.
If you are carrying grief, widowhood, trauma, loss, or judgment from others, I hope this conversation reminds you that your healing journey is personal, sacred, and between you and God.
You are allowed to live again.
💔 From sorrow to strength, nurturing hearts and homes. 🌿 https://www.KneadingToHeal.com 🙏 If this encouraged you, share your thoughts in the comments. I would love to hear where you are in your healing journey.
#grief #widowhood #healingjourney #faith #movingforward #traumahealing #christianencouragement

Who are you… when every label is gone?
Not wife. Not mother. Not homemaker. Not business owner. Not what you do. Not what the world calls you.
Those are roles. Those can be taken. Those can change.
But your true identity?
That cannot be shaken.
In this video, I’m speaking truth over who we really are... not according to the world, but according to God.
I am a daughter of the Most High King.
I am not defined by titles or seasons. I am defined by Him.
Love. Joy. Peace. Patience. Kindness. Goodness. Faithfulness. Gentleness. Self-control.
This is who we are called to be. Salt of the earth. Hand and feet of Jesus.
Not something you strive to become, but who you already are in Christ.
Everything else is temporary. This identity is eternal.
If you’ve ever asked, “Who am I now?” This is your answer.

entry.title: I Lost My Hair After Trauma... Where I Am Now 5 Years Later (My Hair Healing Journey)

media:group.media:title: I Lost My Hair After Trauma... Where I Am Now 5 Years Later (My Hair Healing Journey)
media:group.media:description:
I never thought I would be sharing this… but here we are. hahaha And ONLY for you Guys!
After experiencing trauma years ago from our tragic car accident, I developed stress-induced hair loss/alopecia. It was sudden, overwhelming, and honestly… something I was difficult to talk about for a long time.
For the past three years, I wore protective dreadlock extensions to help preserve what hair I had left. And now… I’ve taken them out.
This video is my real, unfiltered update on my hair journey... where I’ve been, what I’ve tried, and why I made the decision to wear my very first wig at 53 years old.
While I work on restoring my natural hair using MONAT haircare products, I’m also learning something deeper in this season:
Healing isn’t just physical… it’s emotional too.
If you’re struggling with hair loss, alopecia, thinning hair, or even just the fear of trying something new like a wig… you are NOT alone.
This is me stepping into a new chapter... not hiding, not apologizing, just showing up as I am.
And maybe… giving you permission to do the same.
💛 Let me know in the comments: Have you ever struggled with hair loss or considered wearing a wig or a protective hairstyle like dreadlock extensions?

media:group.media:title: After 3 years…
media:group.media:description:
After three years almost to the day, of wearing my hair in a protective hairstyle (braided dreadlock extensions) to help heal my Post-traumatic telogen effluvium or Stress-induced telogen effluvium, or Alopecia, they are coming out. All of the hair dye that I had from coloring my hair over 6 years ago, has all been cut out. I am now solid Salt & Pepper gray!😆 i have had so much new hair growth, especially over the last year. I would say I didn’t have any the entire first year, but slowly as my body has recovered and my hair has been braided away, it has had a chance to heal and recover. My hair is soft, the new growth is like wiret cotton. 😆 But I will take it! My next plan of action now is to treat my hair as if it were still wounded. I am trying the MONAT haircare line on it for the next couple of months. The shampoo, conditioner, and two treatment repairing serums. We shall see how that goes. I am nervous about washing, blowdrying, styling my hair. Having my hair being exposed to the elements of daily wear and tear. So, I am wear my hair in a bun or hair covering. I don’t know yet. This has been a long 5 years of recovery on my body. I can’t believe how much time it has taken and I am still not close to the finish line but GOD is good and we just continue to move forward.
I have shared so much of my healing journey with all of you. I know so many women have experienced trauma induced hairloss as well. I share my story in hopes that if you are also in the battle, you know you are not alone. ❤️‍🩹 If you have any questions for me, let me know. I will try my best to answer them and if I get enough, I can always make a video. 🤗 Love you guys, thanks for all the support through the past 5 years. God bless each and every one of you!🙏🏼

entry.title: They're Making Money Off Your Fear: They Don't Want You Calm, They Want You Clicking!

media:group.media:title: They're Making Money Off Your Fear: They Don't Want You Calm, They Want You Clicking!
media:group.media:description:
They’re making money off your fear… and most people don’t even realize it.
In today’s world of nonstop content, fear has become one of the most powerful tools used to drive clicks, views, and profit. From food and water shortages and rising grocery prices to economic collapse and “urgent warnings”… fear-based content is everywhere!
And here’s the truth: They don’t want you calm… they want you clicking.
In this video, I’m breaking down how fear is being used across YouTube as well as other social media platforms, and even within the prepping and homesteading community to keep you in a constant cycle of anxiety, urgency, and consumption. It makes you addicted to their content for FEAR you will miss an important update that could drastically HARM you and your family in some way.
If you’ve ever walked away from a video feeling overwhelmed, behind, or like you need to rush out and stockpile immediately… this is for you.
We’re talking about: How fear-based content keeps you hooked Why fear sells (and why creators use it) The psychological cycle of panic and urgency How fear impacts your finances and decision-making The difference between true preparedness and panic buying How to step out of fear and into peace, wisdom, and stewardship
Because real preparedness is not rooted in fear, it’s rooted in peace, planning, and purpose.
📖 “For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and a sound mind.” – 2 Timothy 1:7
If you’re tired of feeling anxious, behind, or pressured by what you see online… it’s time to take your peace back.
You don’t need fear to be prepared. You need clarity. You need wisdom. You need calm.
